{"code":"        if not self.connections:
            return None

        now = time.time()

        oldest_idx = min(
            range(len(self.connections)),
            key=lambda idx: self.connections[idx].last_used_at,
        )
        evicted = self.connections.pop(oldest_idx)

        idle_seconds = now - evicted.last_used_at
        return evicted","comments":"Choose the idle connection with the oldest last_used_at timestamp before popping so eviction follows LRU order instead of FIFO."}
